mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; tramadol also has serotonergic activity, and both undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4/2D6, increasing systemic exposure and adverse effects.
action: Monitor closely for anticholinergic toxicity, CNS depression, and serotonin syndrome; consider alternative anticholinergic or analgesic agent; adjust doses cautiously if combination necessary.
